TEXT.citation: Gravius, Daniël. 1661. Het Heylige Evangelium Matthei en Johannis ofte Hagnau Ka D'llig Matiktik. Ka na sasoulat ti Mattheus, ti Johannes appa. Overgeset inde Formosaansche tale, voor de Inwoonders van Soulang, Mattau, Sinckan, Bacloan, Tavocan en Tevorang. Amsterdam: Michiel Hartogh.

S.FORM: Ka ni-mattæ'i-v'lli ta ti Jesus mattæ'i-la neini-æn ki pæ'myhkaulaula'n, ka k'ma,
S.TRANSL: And Jesus answered and spake unto them again by parables, and said,
耶穌又用比喻對他們說：

S.FORM: Mæmyhkaulaula ta Peifa-fou-an ki tounnoun ki vullum ki voual ka Si-bavau Mei-fafou, ka ni-papæhtatanang ki Alak tyn [ka paræh] ki vatouh-an ki pakakyt-tyl-an.
S.TRANSL: The kingdom of heaven is like unto a certain king, which made a marriage for his son,
「天國好比一個王為他兒子擺設娶親的筵席，

S.FORM: Ka ni-madingi ki kouncia tyn patætææ̈m ki ni 'æitannin bana tou ou-vavatoug-eih ki pakakyttil-an, râ ni-ynnang mou-koua.
S.TRANSL: And sent forth his servants to call them that were bidden to the wedding: and they would not come.
就打發僕人去，請那些被召的人來赴席，他們卻不肯來。

S.FORM: Ni-patou-la'n tyn madingi ta pani ki kouncia, ka ni-k'ma, vanavan-'ei ta ni-æi tan-nin bana, K'ytt'ei ni-t'anang-au ta 'i-danga-ranga-au-mau, ni-lpogh ta louang-au ka ni-æhæp, ki ni-touftouf-appa [ka laulong] ka ni-si-ymmid si-kaha sitan, nda ou-koua-au tou ouvavatoughan ki pakakyttil-an.
S.TRANSL: Again, he sent forth other servants, saying, Tell them which are bidden, Behold, I have prepared my dinner: my oxen and my fatlings are killed, and all things are ready: come unto the marriage.
王又打發別的僕人，說：『你們告訴那被召的人，我的筵席已經預備好了，牛和肥畜已經宰了，各樣都齊備，請你們來赴席。』

S.FORM: Râ dou assi nein ni-illigh, ni-d'marang mou-koua teni k'atta tou ouma tyn, teni k'anna tou pæ'i-ass-'an tyn.
S.TRANSL: But they made light of it, and went their ways, one to his farm, another to his merchandise:
那些人不理就走了；一個到自己田裏去；一個做買賣去；

S.FORM: Râ neni ka rarouma dou ni-tmouroung ki kouncia tyn, ni-smamuk pakapat-ei neini-æn.
S.TRANSL: And the remnant took his servants, and entreated them spitefully, and slew them.
其餘的拿住僕人，凌辱他們，把他們殺了。

S.FORM: Irou ka millingigh [ki atta] ta Mei-sasou ka Si-bavau, ni-'æhæg-næng-æ-yddyngdyngyt ta teni, ka rou ni-pad-ading-i-en tyn ta kabatoung-an ki ta'u ka macyt, ni-sidada tyn ta tama-lpogh k'anna, ka na pæ-æ̈-'idigh tyn ki apoei ta euma nein.
S.TRANSL: But when the king heard thereof, he was wroth: and he sent forth his armies, and destroyed those murderers, and burned up their city.
王就大怒，發兵除滅那些兇手，燒毀他們的城。

S.FORM: Anna ta ni-koun tyn ki kouncia tyn-nda, Peikahan-ato mei-tanan ta vatough ki pakakyttil-an, râ neni ka ni-æi-tan-nin bana, assi mamsing irang ki kidi.
S.TRANSL: Then saith he to his servants, The wedding is ready, but they which were bidden were not worthy.
於是對僕人說：『喜筵已經齊備，只是所召的人不配。

S.FORM: Alei ki anna u-pænæ'-æu tou pta ki darang, ka papynna-pynna ki voual ka kabalei-au-moumi, tiddau-auto pa-oukoua tou ou-vavatoug-eih ki pakakyttil-an.
S.TRANSL: Go ye therefore into the highways, and as many as ye shall find, bid to the marriage.
所以你們要往岔路口上去，凡遇見的，都召來赴席。』

S.FORM: Ka rou tpæpænæh ta koungcia k'anna tou dara-darang, nipapakoilau ymmid ka ni-kabalei nein, ka mat'e mariang-appa, ka ni-matmoei ta vatough ki æ'ia-roung.
S.TRANSL: So those servants went out into the highways, and gathered together all as many as they found, both bad and good: and the wedding was furnished with guests.
那些僕人就出去，到大路上，凡遇見的，不論善惡都召聚了來，筵席上就坐滿了客。

S.FORM: Irou ka ni-mou-rbo ta Meisasou ka Si-bavau tou hi-matta-eih tyn ta æ'ia-roung, ni-k'ytt'an tyn ta ta'u ka assi mahkoulamough tou ou-vavatough-an ki pakakyttil-an-da.
S.TRANSL: And when the king came in to see the guests, he saw there a man which had not on a wedding garment:
王進來觀看賓客，見那裏有一個沒有穿禮服的，

S.FORM: Ka ni-k'ma tyni-æn, Diou, mamang ta ni-ou-rbo-en-hou hia rou assi-kow mah-koulamough ki ou-vavatouvatough? Ka ni-makdigh ki marat ta teni.
S.TRANSL: And he saith unto him, Friend, how camest thou in hither not having a wedding garment? And he was speechless.
就對他說：『朋友，你到這裏來怎麼不穿禮服呢？』那人無言可答。

S.FORM: Anna ta ni-k'ma ta Meisasou ka Si-bavau ki Pææ̈iroung-en tyn, Hali-rima-ei, hali-rahpal-ei, arau, 'aryngan-ei tyni-æn tou karimdim-an ka siouro itou-tauagh: Tou hynna-al-ato ta t'angi-t'angi-en ki pat-ityng-en-appa ki waligh.
S.TRANSL: Then said the king to the servants, Bind him hand and foot, and take him away, and cast him into outer darkness, there shall be weeping and gnashing of teeth.
於是王對使喚的人說：『捆起他的手腳來，把他丟在外邊的黑暗裏；在那裏必要哀哭切齒了。』

S.FORM: Ka mabatoung ta ni-tatææ̈m, râ matiting ta ni-peri.
S.TRANSL: For many are called, but few are chosen.
因為被召的人多，選上的人少。」

S.FORM: Tou kidi k'anna ni-d'marang ti Fariséen ka ni-mattæ'i-sâl ki sou, alei ka teih-douk-ah tihkla ki pattæ'i-rouh-kin ki sou nein tyni-æn.
S.TRANSL: Then went the Pharisees, and took counsel how they might entangle him in his talk.
當時，法利賽人出去商議，怎樣就着耶穌的話陷害他，

S.FORM: Ka ni-padingi-en nein paou-koua tyni-æn ta Pahtatæutæuug-han nein lam ki Herodianen, komma-koua, Tama-mahtæutæuugh, kavana'nian ka matiktik kow ki sou, ka mæhtæutæuugh kow ki darang ki Alid tou katiktik-an, ka mang-au-'m hou ta timamang ka ta'u: ka assi kow masa'u-kulkul ki vlung ki ta'u.
S.TRANSL: And they sent out unto him their disciples with the Herodians, saying, Master, we know that thou art true, and teachest the way of God in truth, neither carest thou for any man: for thou regardest not the person of men.
就打發他們的門徒同希律黨的人去見耶穌，說：「夫子，我們知道你是誠實人，並且誠誠實實傳上帝的道，甚麼人你都不徇情面，因為你不看人的外貌。

S.FORM: Anna ta vana-van'ei-kame, Mamang ta rÿh-euho? hahei-en kaua pi'æ̈ ki Mei-sasou ka Si-atigh Si-bavau ta 'æ̈ymhgan, assi lava hahei-en?
S.TRANSL: Tell us therefore, What thinkest thou? Is it lawful to give tribute unto Caesar, or not?
請告訴我們，你的意見如何？納稅給凱撒可以不可以？」

S.FORM: Râ tou kalang-in Jesus ta sasamk'en ki rÿh nein, ni-k'ma neini-æn,
S.TRANSL: But Jesus perceived their wickedness, and said, Why tempt ye me, ye hypocrites?
耶穌看出他們的惡意，就說：「假冒為善的人哪，為甚麼試探我？

S.FORM: Ymoumi ka panni-nni-en ki rÿh ki sou, ka mang ta rarpung-'noumi jau-an? Pa-k'ytta-au koh ta malyttok ka 'æ̈ymhgan. Ka ni-ad-nein tyni-æn ta denarium [ka malyttok ka ni-patag-hen.]
S.TRANSL: Shew me the tribute money. And they brought unto him a penny.
拿一個上稅的錢給我看！」他們就拿一個銀錢來給他。

S.FORM: Ka ni-k'ma neini-æn, Ah timang ta pa-souh-ta'u-ta'u-en k'atta? na 'æ'æ̈hahalap-appa ka patagh?
S.TRANSL: And he saith unto them, Whose is this image and superscription?
耶穌說：「這像和這號是誰的？」

S.FORM: Ni-k'ma tyni-æn, A tou Si-atigh Si-bavau. Anna ta ni-k'ma neini-æn, P'hei-to ki Si-atigh Sibavau ka atou Si-atigh Si-bavau, ki Alid-appa ka atou Alid-râ.
S.TRANSL: They say unto him, Caesar's. Then saith he unto them, Render therefore unto Caesar the things which are Caesar's; and unto God the things that are God's.
他們說：「是凱撒的。」耶穌說：「這樣，凱撒的物當歸給凱撒；上帝的物當歸給上帝。」

S.FORM: Irou ka millingigh ta neni ki atta, ni-mouh-kiap-ato: ka rou pa-yhka-koua tyni-æn, ni-dmarang ta neni.
S.TRANSL: When they had heard these words, they marvelled, and left him, and went their way.
他們聽見就希奇，離開他走了。

S.FORM: Tou wæ'i k'anna ierrou-ato moukoua tyni-æn ta Sadduceen, ka k'ma-kouakoua hynna, ka aou-si-ah ta likough-eih æhpit, ka ni-tmaligh tyni-æn,
S.TRANSL: The same day came to him the Sadducees, which say that there is no resurrection, and asked him,
撒都該人常說沒有復活的事。那天，他們來問耶穌說：

S.FORM: K'ma, Tama-mahtæutæuugh ni-k'ma ta ti Moses, Heirou mapatei ta timamang ka aöusi ki alalak, anna ta pou-tbung-ah ta tæ'i-a-para tyn ki ni-keiæ̈en tyn, ka pæ'æhpit-ah ki æp ki tæ'i-apara tyn.
S.TRANSL: Saying, Master, Moses said, If a man die, having no children, his brother shall marry his wife, and raise up seed unto his brother.
「夫子，摩西說：『人若死了，沒有孩子，他兄弟當娶他的妻，為哥哥生子立後。』

S.FORM: Nda na akou-papyttou ki mahtæiappapara ymiæn-æn, ka naunamou ka ni-pou-tbung ta ni-map-atei-ato, ka alei ka aousi ki alalak, ni-pa-tbli ki ni-keiæ̈ tyn ki tæ'i-apara tyn.
S.TRANSL: Now there were with us seven brethren: and the first, when he had married a wife, deceased, and, having no issue, left his wife unto his brother:
從前，在我們這裏有弟兄七人，第一個娶了妻，死了，沒有孩子，撇下妻子給兄弟。

S.FORM: Ni-mahkaulaula k'omma-hynna ta ti kara-rouha, ta ti katatourou, mah-kidi-appa ki kapapyttou.
S.TRANSL: Likewise the second also, and the third, unto the seventh.
第二、第三，直到第七個，都是如此。

S.FORM: Tou 'æ̈ugh ki ymmid neini-æn ni-pis-koua-appa mapatei ta jna.
S.TRANSL: And last of all the woman died also.
末後，婦人也死了。

S.FORM: Anna ta tou likough-eih æhpit, a timang-ah ta kei'en ki papyttou k'anna? dou ni-pou-ymmid nein pou-tbung tyni-æn.
S.TRANSL: Therefore in the resurrection whose wife shall she be of the seven? for they all had her.
這樣，當復活的時候，她是七個人中哪一個的妻子呢？因為他們都娶過她。」

S.FORM: Râ ni-mattæ'i-vlli ta ti Jesus, k'ma-hia neini-æn, Taura-heï-kamou tou assi kavan'an ki na sasoulat ki ligh-appa ki Alid.
S.TRANSL: Jesus answered and said unto them, Ye do err, not knowing the scriptures, nor the power of God.
耶穌回答說：「你們錯了；因為不明白聖經，也不曉得上帝的大能。

S.FORM: Nda tou likough-eih æhpit assi pou-tbung-ah, assi papoutbung-an-eih-appa: râ mam'al-ato ki Tamahnau ki Alid tou tounoun ki vullum.
S.TRANSL: For in the resurrection they neither marry, nor are given in marriage, but are as the angels of God in heaven.
當復活的時候，人也不娶也不嫁，乃像天上的使者一樣。

S.FORM: Ka atou likough-eih æhpit, assi-moumi kaua ni-kting ta ni-pasousou-en ki Alid ymoumi-æn, ka k'ma.
S.TRANSL: But as touching the resurrection of the dead, have ye not read that which was spoken unto you by God, saying,
論到死人復活，上帝在經上向你們所說的，你們沒有念過嗎？

S.FORM: Ti jau ta Alid ti Abraham, ta Alid ti Isaak, ta Alid-appa ti Jakob? Alid ta assi Alid ki patei, râ ki mæuæh.
S.TRANSL: I am the God of Abraham, and the God of Isaac, and the God of Jacob? God is not the God of the dead, but of the living.
他說：『我是亞伯拉罕的上帝，以撒的上帝，雅各的上帝。』上帝不是死人的上帝，乃是活人的上帝。」

S.FORM: Irou ka millingigh [ki atta] ta makoilalaulau ni-mauhki-ap-ato ki na pæhtatæutæuugh tyn.
S.TRANSL: And when the multitude heard this, they were astonished at his doctrine.
眾人聽見這話，就希奇他的教訓。

S.FORM: Râ tou illing-hen ki Fariséen ka ni tkid tyn ta moutos ki Sadduceen, ni-mæua-sâl mæuakla ta neni.
S.TRANSL: But when the Pharisees had heard that he had put the Sadducees to silence, they were gathered together.
法利賽人聽見耶穌堵住了撒都該人的口，他們就聚集。

S.FORM: Ka saat neini-æn ka Mahtæutæuugh ki Tatouhko ta ni-rihpung tmaligh tyni-æn, k'ma.
S.TRANSL: Then one of them, which was a lawyer, asked him a question, tempting him, and saying,
內中有一個人是律法師，要試探耶穌，就問他說：

S.FORM: Tama-mahtæutæuugh, kamang ta sou ka pah-kousasousou ki keirang-en tou Tatouhko?
S.TRANSL: Master, which is the great commandment in the law?
「夫子，律法上的誡命，哪一條是最大的呢？」

S.FORM: Râ ni-k'ma ta ti Jesus tyni-æn, Mavæ'ango-ah kow ki Meirang ka Alid oho tou tyntin-noho ka myhta tmouk, tou vatti-oho ka myhtatmouk, tou ymd-appa ki ou-mhga-en hou pæh-dimdim.
S.TRANSL: Jesus said unto him, Thou shalt love the Lord thy God with all thy heart, and with all thy soul, and with all thy mind.
耶穌對他說：「你要盡心、盡性、盡意愛主－你的上帝。

S.FORM: Atta ta sou ka pahkousasousou ka naunamou ki keirang-en.
S.TRANSL: This is the first and great commandment.
這是誡命中的第一，且是最大的。

S.FORM: Râ kararouha ta mahkaulaula ki atta: Mavæango-ah kow ki ta'u ka rarouma mama mamado ymhou-an.
S.TRANSL: And the second is like unto it, Thou shalt love thy neighbour as thyself.
其次也相倣，就是要愛人如己。

S.FORM: Tou rourouha ki pahkousasousou k'atta 'æul-in ta ymmid ki Tatouhko ki na Tama-mattæ'i-tan-appa.
S.TRANSL: On these two commandments hang all the law and the prophets.
這兩條誡命是律法和先知一切道理的總綱。」

S.FORM: Irou ka makoi-sâl-ato ta Fariséen, ni-tmaligh neini-æn ta ti Jesus,
S.TRANSL: While the Pharisees were gathered together, Jesus asked them,
法利賽人聚集的時候，耶穌問他們說：

S.FORM: Ka k'ma, pæ'mang-'noumi ta ti Christus? Alak ti mang ta teni? Ni-k'ma ta neini tyni-æn, na Alak ti David.
S.TRANSL: Saying, What think ye of Christ? whose son is he? They say unto him, The son of David.
「論到基督，你們的意見如何？他是誰的子孫呢？」他們回答說：「是大衛的子孫。」

S.FORM: Ni-k'ma neini-æn mamei-mang ka mananang tyni-æn ta ti David ki Joepan, ki Meirang-tyn, dou k'ma,
S.TRANSL: He saith unto them, How then doth David in spirit call him Lord, saying,
耶穌說：「這樣，大衛被聖靈感動，怎麼還稱他為主，說：

S.FORM: Ni-masousou ta Meirang ki Meirang-au, mierroung-a tou ouwal-au tou kidi ka pa-itou koua-aul-ato mau ta sivæuæuvæuugh ymhou-an tou kahkakou-an ki rahpal oho?
S.TRANSL: The LORD said unto my Lord, Sit thou on my right hand, till I make thine enemies thy footstool?
主對我主說： 你坐在我的右邊， 等我把你仇敵放在你的腳下。

S.FORM: Heirou mananang ta ti David tyni-æn, Meirang, mamei-mang ka na Alak tyn ta [teni?]
S.TRANSL: If David then call him Lord, how is he his son?
大衛既稱他為主，他怎麼又是大衛的子孫呢？」

S.FORM: Ka assi mattæi-lpough ta timamang mattæ'i-vlli tyni-æn ki sasasat ki sou: ka ni-maneianei ta timamang siæ̈ugh ki kidi ki wæ'i k'anna tmauki-lala tyni-æn.
S.TRANSL: And no man was able to answer him a word, neither durst any man from that day forth ask him any more questions.
他們沒有一個人能回答一言。從那日以後，也沒有人敢再問他甚麼。
